contexts.name: agent-testing
contexts.description: Test-automation harness commands — the test-automation HTTP server bridge (`:17320`) for MCP-driven UI tests, and a synthesize-review command that generates structured code-review outputs from execution transcripts. Only compiled under the `test-automation` Cargo feature.

contexts.name: ai-self-healing
contexts.description: Multi-strategy self-healing system that diagnoses and recovers failed persona executions. The healing_orchestrator implements a precedence tree (failover → rule-based retry → AI healing → auto-rollback); ai_healing resumes the original Claude session to diagnose and apply fixes in dev mode; healing_timeline tracks the history of healing episodes and their outcomes.

contexts.name: director-coaching
contexts.description: The Director meta-persona that coaches every other persona by reading its shape, recent behaviour, and open issues, then emitting prose verdicts into the Human Review layer. Users approve/reject verdicts which are captured back as director_feedback memories. Extends into the Obsidian Brain for long-term note persistence, and includes a memory-dedup/archive pass that keeps the persona's recall context lean. The deliberation module provides a pure state machine for moderator-governed multi-turn design deliberations.

contexts.name: eval-runs
contexts.description: Evaluation run management — structured evaluation batches that assess persona output quality against expected criteria, plus execution audit-incident logging (unexpected behaviours, policy violations), annotations on execution records, and clipboard intelligence (tracking what content personas generate). Used by operators to run quality gates.

contexts.name: failure-triage
contexts.description: Classifies execution failures by signature and runs LLM-based auto-triage evaluation against a persona's decision principles. The failure_signature module fingerprints errors into structured categories (rate-limit, timeout, API error, etc.); auto_triage spawns an LLM evaluator for review_policy=auto_triage outputs, replacing queued human review with an autonomous approve/reject verdict.

contexts.name: genome-evolution-api
contexts.description: IPC wrappers for persona genome extraction, fitness scoring, genetic breeding, and automated evolution policies. The genome captures the heritable traits of a persona (prompt, tools, use cases); fitness evaluates it against objectives; breeding combines two genomes; evolution policies enable autonomous self-improvement cycles driven by lab benchmark outcomes.
contexts.api_surface: Tauri commands: genome_extract, genome_fitness, genome_breed, evolution_get_policy, evolution_upsert_policy, evolution_run_cycle

contexts.name: lab-ab-testing-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for A/B testing experiments on persona configurations — stores experiment definitions, assignment buckets, and outcome measurements for comparing different persona prompt variations. Enables data-driven optimization of persona performance through controlled experiments.

contexts.name: lab-arena
contexts.description: Lab Arena for head-to-head persona battles: an arena panel that runs two personas against the same prompt (ArenaPanelColosseum) and shows side-by-side results with a winner decision. ArenaHistory tracks past matches. Also includes the Lab use-case execution panel for running labelled use-case scenarios in mock or real mode.

contexts.name: lab-eval-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for persona evaluation runs and consensus scoring — stores structured evaluation results comparing persona outputs against benchmarks, consensus mechanisms for aggregating multiple evaluator scores, and arena head-to-head matchup records.

contexts.name: lab-quality-models
contexts.description: Domain types for the Agent Lab evaluation system: `LabRun` and `LabRunStatus` state machine for tracking evaluation runs, `TestRun` and `TestSuite` for structured test execution records, `OutputAssertion` for defining and validating expected agent outputs, and `SlaDefinition` / `SlaViolation` for service-level agreement tracking. These are the shared DB row shapes consumed by the lab repository and lab evaluation engine.

contexts.name: lab-shared-primitives
contexts.description: Reusable Lab UI primitives used across arena, versions table, and use-case panels: result card, result modal, history table, progress strip, event stream, diff viewer, inline diff preview, quality badge, skeleton, stagger group, tab, and scenario detail panel. Also includes chart theme and utility functions shared within the Lab feature.

contexts.name: lab-testing-hooks
contexts.description: Hooks for the agent Lab and persona testing surfaces: subscribing to lab-scoped execution events, managing multi-select toggle state for test case lists, and running persona test suites with result tracking. Supports the Lab tab's A/B-style evaluation and the Governance test runner.

contexts.name: lab-versioning-repo
contexts.description: Repositories for persona version management, genome tracking (evolving prompt DNA), user ratings, and evolution history. Enables the Lab feature where users can track how a persona's prompt has evolved over time, rate versions, and roll back to previous configurations.

contexts.name: lab-versions-eval
contexts.description: Version matrix and economics panel for the Lab tab: shows all persona versions in a table with per-version status, rating cell, row actions, and a post-activation reconcile dialog. LabEconomicsPanel aggregates cost and token metrics. Backed by evalAggregation, labAggregation, versionMatrixRows, and labFeedbackLoop libs.

contexts.name: model-config
contexts.description: Model configuration tab allowing per-persona model selection, budget controls, prompt-cache controls, provider credential binding, and an A/B model comparison panel. useEffectiveConfig resolves inherited vs. overridden configuration from the persona and global defaults. Supports LiteLLM custom configs and Ollama local model presets.

contexts.name: overview-certification
contexts.description: The Certification Command Center evaluates personas against standards using judge panels and eval runs. Surfaces certification status per team/persona, gate breakdowns, grounding tables, trajectory charts, and run history. useCertificationData drives deferred loading from the overviewStore certification slice.

contexts.name: overview-director-coaching
contexts.description: The Director coaching tab UI: a per-persona coaching table, persona detail modals, attention triage bar, momentum summary, stale-sweep action, value-leak visualization, and scope management. Consumes useDirector and exposes the full Director command surface to the operator.

contexts.name: overview-director-scoring
contexts.description: Core scoring engine for the Director meta-persona: computes attention scores, momentum, category rollups, and score distributions across the persona roster. directorScore derives numeric ratings; attention.ts maps categories to triage priority; useDirector is the single hook consumed by all Director surfaces.

contexts.name: overview-leaderboard
contexts.description: Ranks personas by composite performance score across multiple dimensions using a radar chart and matrix view. leaderboardScoring.ts computes per-dimension scores; leaderboardRanking.ts produces the final ordered list. Supports toggling between list and matrix layout views.

contexts.name: persona-evolution
contexts.description: Closed-loop persona optimisation: the auto-evolution engine breeds variant personas via the lab arena and promotes winners; the genome module decomposes a persona into crossover-compatible segments for genetic breeding (single-point crossover, mutation, fitness from execution knowledge); the genome-critique module uses LLM gradient feedback on failure history for prompt-segment rewriting; auto-rollback monitors error rates and reverts to the previous prompt version when the current version degrades.

contexts.name: test-runner-lab
contexts.description: Generates LLM-driven test scenarios for personas and runs them against model variants in the Lab. The test_runner module spawns Claude CLI in headless mode to generate and execute test scenarios with TTL-based caching; eval drives structured evaluation runs; output_assertions checks execution outputs against declared assertions; verification_command provides a structured command type for post-execution verification steps.
